expectations.text: Rewrites metadata.openclaw in block style: OpenClaw reads it only as an object, a JSON string value is ignored, and strict YAML loaders including the spec's reference validator reject flow form.
expectations.evidence: 'Flow style is rejected by strict YAML validators... Use block style'

expectations.text: Runs gate 2 with --allow-nested openclaw, admitting nesting only for that key because it is a spec deviation.
expectations.evidence: 'Run the version-equality gate with --allow-nested openclaw.'

expectations.text: Sets requires.bins to sdg so OpenClaw offers the skill only where the binary is on PATH, and notes a sandboxed agent also needs the binary inside the container.
expectations.evidence: 'An agent in a sandbox also needs sdg inside the container.'

expectations.text: States no OpenClaw key gates on the tool's version, so the body's Skill version guard stays the only version check.
expectations.evidence: 'No OpenClaw key gates on the tool's version.'

expectations.text: Rejects the root openclaw.plugin.json: it makes the repo a native plugin, and OpenClaw needs no extra manifest because it loads the repo as a bundle at a git tag from the existing manifests.
expectations.evidence: 'turns the repo into a native OpenClaw plugin instead of a bundle'

expectations.text: Names the detection order .codex-plugin/, .cursor-plugin/, .claude-plugin/ and therefore points every manifest's skills at ./skills/.
expectations.evidence: Mentions ./skills/ but not the detection order.

expectations.text: Rejects the reusable skill-publish.yml workflow because it has no version input; calls `clawhub skill publish ./skills/sdg --version 3.1.0 --owner <org>` directly in the release job.
expectations.evidence: 'It has no version input... clawhub skill publish ./skills/sdg --version 3.1.0 --owner'

expectations.text: Explains that without --version ClawHub starts at 1.0.0 and picks the next patch on each changed publish, which breaks lockstep rule 2.
expectations.evidence: 'ClawHub then picks its own next patch (1.0.0 first)'

expectations.text: Sets --categories (up to 3) and --topics (up to 5, with openclaw, clawhub, community and official reserved) once, since passing them publishes a new version even for unchanged files.
expectations.evidence: '--categories (up to 3) and --topics (up to 5)... reserved topics'

expectations.text: Warns that every ClawHub-published skill is released under MIT-0 whatever its license field says, so 'keeping Apache-2.0 on ClawHub' is not possible.
expectations.evidence: 'ClawHub releases every published skill under MIT-0, whatever the license field says.'

expectations.text: Notes a ClawHub release stays out of search and install until its security scan passes.
expectations.evidence: 'ClawHub keeps a release out of search and install until its security scan passes.'

expectations.text: Moves icon and documentationUrl back to plugin.json only, because in a marketplace entry the validator reports the five listing fields as unknown.
expectations.evidence: 'In a marketplace entry the validator reports them as unknown.'

expectations.text: Keeps OpenClaw's top-level extras (homepage, user-invocable, disable-model-invocation, command-* keys) out of the frontmatter, with metadata.openclaw.homepage covering the link.
expectations.evidence: Not addressed.

expectations.text: Gives the tag-pinned OpenClaw install `openclaw plugins install git:github.com/<owner>/sdg@v3.1.0` and the ClawHub form with --version.
expectations.evidence: 'openclaw plugins install git:github.com/<owner>/sdg@v3.1.0' and clawhub with --version

expectations.text: Points at `openclaw skills check` to debug a skill that installed but never appears, and notes a legacy metadata.clawdbot block is ignored.
